result.text:
🚨 Here's why it could be a BAD move for the Mets if Tarik Skubal accepts their reported 9-year, nearly $400 million offer:

1️⃣ The injury history. Skubal has already undergone Tommy John surgery, flexor tendon surgery, and another procedure on his throwing elbow. Committing nearly a decade to a pitcher with that history is a massive gamble.

2️⃣ The age factor. Skubal turned 30 a few days ago. A nine-year deal means the Mets are potentially paying him close to $45 million annually into his late 30s. That's insane.

3️⃣ The opportunity cost. Nearly $400 million tied up in one pitcher limits the financial flexibility to address multiple other holes on this roster. Especially with David Stearns as your POBO.

⚾ Skubal is an incredible pitcher, but there's a difference between wanting him and being willing to give him almost $400 million over nine years. Not ideal right now. 

#LGM
